description: PUT /v1/sources/{sha256} (putSource), PUT /v1/assets/blobs/{sha256} (putAssetBlob) and PUT /v1/apps/{project}/r2/{bucket}/objects/{key} (putR2Object) take their bytes as the whole request body: the spec declares `requestBody: application/octet-stream` with `{type: string, format: binary}` on each. The converter reads JSON, form and multipart bodies only, so the three operations generated with no body member and could not upload anything. Give each input a required `body` Blob payload and send it as application/octet-stream, as Sproutboat's own walk-through does (`curl -X PUT ... -H 'content-type: application/octet-stream' --data-binary @file`, https://sproutboat.com/docs/api/build-a-provider).

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The app's generated JavaScript: at most 8 MiB, non-empty, valid UTF-8. `sha256` must be the SHA-256 of exactly these bytes.
The file's bytes, at most 64 MiB. `sha256` must be the SHA-256 of exactly these bytes.
The object's bytes, at most 64 MiB.
